chunks: In fact, they are clear signs in the minds of those who have intelligence. No one denies Our revelations except those who are unjust.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people that hold the clear signs of the Quran in their chests?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'those endowed with knowledge' (Ahl al-Ilm) is often interpreted specifically as the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, who possess the esoteric understanding of the Quran. This verse highlights that true recognition of divine signs requires not just intellectual capacity but spiritual purity, as the unjust (Al-Zalimun) are uniquely prone to denial due to their inner corruption. It establishes a direct link between gnosis (Ma'rifah) and the preservation of revelation within the heart.
